review_comment: The change enables HTML parsing in MarkdownIt without implementing HTML sanitization, allowing user-controlled HTML content to pass through to rendered output. This creates an XSS vulnerability where malicious scripts in markdown input could execute in users' browsers. Remove 'html: true' from the MarkdownIt configuration or implement proper HTML sanitization using a library like DOMPurify before rendering the output.

The added code directly outputs HTML content from markdown tokens without encoding, creating an XSS vulnerability when user-controlled content is processed. Apply HTML entity encoding to t.content before output, or use a secure HTML sanitization library to remove dangerous elements while preserving safe markup.

The patch introduces HTML
tags into table cell content without proper escaping. While this specific change only adds safe tags, the pattern of inserting raw HTML without validation creates a potential injection vector. Apply HTML escaping to all user-controlled content before inserting HTML tags, or use markdown-safe line break syntax instead of raw HTML.
